correctness.rationale: In the rank-five hyperplane sigma1=0 over Z_(2), F=sigma2^2-4sigma4 has nonzero reduction sigma2^2 and gives a torsion-free primitive flat Cartier hypersurface. The reduced support Q:sigma2=0 is smooth because its binary polar radical is the all-ones vector, on which q=sigma2=1. On the paired-coordinate subspace x_i=x_j=a etc and a+b+c=0, an explicit polynomial identity annihilates F integrally. Over F2 its Q-rational points are exactly the 15 weight-four vectors, indexed by duads, and its 15 F2 lines are exactly perfect-matchings of six labels, each with three points and each point on three lines. Q(F_{2^m})=(q+1)(q^2+1), the reduced line union has 15(q+1)-30 points, yielding q^3+q^2-14q+16 and the displayed zeta. Independently enumerated all 15 F2 points and all 15 rational lines; inspected F4 checker source for the 85-point count. The result concerns a specified primitive integral model, not the different modular characteristic-two model.
